- Installation guidance: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/
- Supplied by the project owner after downloading through the corporate proxy.

- Package metadata: `xlsx@0.20.3`, Apache-2.0; license included in the archive.

The local archive avoids CDN authentication during CI and Jetson deployment.
The hash records the received file's integrity; it is not an independent
publisher signature verification. npm also records the archive integrity in
`package-lock.json`. The package has no install lifecycle scripts.
